verdict.rationale: Jira's own site says users can 'bring context to your AI stack with our MCP', and a probe found an official Atlassian MCP server repository, so an agent can connect through a first-party MCP server. The evidence is thin: one marketing line and a repository pointer, with nothing on setup, tools exposed, auth or scope. Missing for 10: documentation of setup and authentication, the list of exposed tools/capabilities, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: bring context to your AI stack with our MCP and CLI
